title: Wire version versus durable compatibility boundary
summary: queue.transport/2 is an intentional remote-wire change inside a package whose aggregate Queue Fabric identity remains 0.9. Durable queue record identities, transmission envelope identities and QAUTH2 storage formats are not rewritten by the transport upgrade.
invariants: A wire-protocol upgrade is not automatically a persistence-format upgrade.
Do not modify durable record identities merely to match the socket protocol number.
Compatibility claims require executable evidence; dev5 qualification did not freshly rerun exact v0.8.2 bilateral compatibility because the exact source tree was unavailable.

provenance.claim: README distinguishes aggregate API, intentional queue.transport/2 wire change and unchanged durable identities.
Fresh v0.8.2 compatibility and later long crypto modes are explicit non-claims.
